notes: The home screen now downloads a little less code before it appears: the bot-controller code that only the arrows need loads when a level starts.
Once your commander is outside the gate and within shooting range of where the raiders attack, the Fend off the raiders arrows go away; away from that spot they still show.
In Levels 8, 11, 14, 16, 32, 41, 50 and 52, a build pad that hid behind the shop or a scrap heap now stays in view: the pad, or what hid it, moved a few steps.
The game now downloads fewer font files and fetches the two used on the home screen first, so its text appears sooner.
The home screen now paints its scene straight away on a first visit, with the video fading in over it.
The home screen now lets its title video start before the background downloads begin, so it appears sooner.
The home screen asks for its title video first, so the animated background shows up sooner on a first visit.
The floating pin over a hidden build pad now fills with your payment, in step with the ring on the ground.
Behind the scenes: a more accurate check for build pads hidden behind buildings, so future levels can be kept clear; nothing changes in play yet.
Level 30 was re-laid out, but its cashier build pad can still hide behind a wall.
Four older levels (14, 38, 49 and 58) were re-laid out, but some of their build pads can still hide behind a building.
Scrap no longer piles up on your commander's back; it only counts in the balance at the top of the screen.
A red ! now bobs over your commander when health is down to 3, so you can step out of a fight before being knocked down.
When your commander is knocked down on a level with a med bay, a big red ! shows over them, the screen edge flashes red and the phone buzzes.

The first time you open the game it now shows a Preparing the outpost screen that downloads everything for offline play, with a real progress bar, a Wi-Fi choice on mobile data, and a Retry if the connection drops.
Correction to an earlier note: some build pads can still hide behind a building or wall; they are being moved into view level by level.
Walled attack levels now face the camera side.
In the opening film, your commander now turns to look round by shuffling his feet instead of sliding them, and the film is back to its original brightness.
On new defend levels, turrets now stand right beside the road they guard, with their build pads tucked in behind them.
